verdict.rationale: Ramp has a dedicated multi-entity page indicating it can sync transactions and reimbursement data across multiple entities in one step, and reimbursements support 70+ countries/40 currencies, suggesting multi-entity/multi-currency support. However, the evidence pack lacks detail on consolidated reporting dashboards or explicit per-entity books/chart-of-accounts separation. Missing for 10: explicit consolidated reporting evidence, per-entity ledger/books detail, multi-currency accounting (not just reimbursement) specifics.
